text: (1) Non-Chinese citizens holding valid ordinary passports of a foreign country; (2) In good health, aged between 18 and 25; for those applying for a master's degree, the age should generally not exceed 30. (3) No criminal record, and agree to abide by the laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China and the relevant management rules of our university; (4) To apply for the undergraduate program, one must have a high school diploma or higher education; to apply for the postgraduate program, one must have a bachelor's degree or higher.
